input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Unify error handling on BivvyError, remove anyhow

Replace anyhow::Result with crate::error::Result across all modules
(cache, registry, feedback, session, shell, config, updates, CLI).
Every .context() and anyhow::bail!() call is replaced with typed
BivvyError variants (FetchError, UpdateError, CacheError, ParseError,
SessionError, FeedbackError, CommandFailed, UntrustedUrl), preserving
contextual error messages while enabling callers to match on error
kind. The anyhow crate is removed from dependencies entirely.
EOF
)"
